name: ARX Equity Partners

entity_kind.quote: With more than € 300 million raised in four funds, ARX has become a leading private equity firm in its segment operating in the Central European (“CE”) region.

investor_type.quote: ARX Equity Partners (“ARX”), a leading Central European private equity firm, today announced the acquisition of a majority stake in Medicofit, fizioterapija d.o.o. (“Medicofit” or the “Company”), Slovenia’s foremost private provider of integrated musculoskeletal care.

stages.quote: Our firm also provides financing to entrepreneurially-minded managers in order to fund management buy-out and management buy-in (MBO & MBI) transactions.

aum.quote: ARX has successfully raised and managed four successive private equity funds, with more than € 300 million under management.

investments.quote: ARX Equity Partners (“ARX”), a leading Central European private equity firm, today announced the acquisition of a majority stake in Medicofit, fizioterapija d.o.o. (“Medicofit” or the “Company”), Slovenia’s foremost private provider of integrated musculoskeletal care.
ARX Equity Partners (“ARX”) has become a lead investor in Direct4me, d.o.o. (“Direct4me” or the “Company”)

ARX Equity Partners has acquired a majority stake in PROXY Holding a.s., the holding company of PROXY, a.s. and PROXY – AUDIT, s.r.o., a professional services provider in the Czech Republic, operating under the brand HLB PROXY.

notes: Generalist mid-market PE (HQ Prague, office in Poland). Investments page lists deals only in CZ, PL, HU, SI, HR; no Slovak portfolio company found, so SK is not in active_in. SLOVCA lists 'Preferovaná výška investície: EUR 10-50 mil.' but ARX's own site says companies 'typically valued between € 10 million and € 50 million', so ticket fields were left empty; AUM is total commitments since inception.
